images.addBookmark: Add bookmark at the view centre (B)
images.keys: Image. Plus and minus zoom, 0 shows 100 percent, F fits the image, R rotates, arrow keys pan. V, C, M and N choose a tool, Enter picks a point at the cursor or the view centre, Escape cancels the tool.
images.notCalibrated: Not calibrated: distances are in image pixels only. Use Calibrate to measure in millimetres.
images.outside: Pick a point inside the image.
images.samePoint: The two points are less than one image pixel apart. Pick points farther apart.
images.shortReference: Short reference: a longer known distance gives a more accurate scale.
images.distanceLabel: Real distance between the two points
images.distanceHint: Enter the real distance in millimetres, for example 25.4.
images.notePlaceholder: Describe what is at this point
images.limitBookmarks: The bookmark limit for this document has been reached.
images.limitNotes: The note limit for this document has been reached.
images.sanitized: Nothing in this file was run or loaded from the network.
images.removedSummary: Unsafe content removed from this SVG: {count}
images.errorLimit: Image too large to open safely
images.errorDecode: This image could not be decoded
images.openFailed: The image could not be opened.
images.calibrated: Calibrated: {ratio} px per mm (1 mm = {pixels} px). Measurements now report millimetres.
images.calibrationFailed: The calibration could not be computed.
images.calibrationCleared: Calibration cleared. Distances are reported in image pixels only.
images.hintCalibrateFirst: Calibrate: click the first end of a distance you know, for example a ruler in the photo.
images.hintCalibrateSecond: Click the second end of the known distance.
images.hintMeasureFirstUncalibrated: Measure: click the first point. Not calibrated, so distances are in pixels only.
images.hintNote: Add note: click the image where the note belongs.
images.noBookmarks: No bookmarks yet. Press B to save the current view centre.
images.noNotes: No notes yet. Choose the note tool (N) and click the image.
